pokedexEntries.bk: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

pokedexEntries.wh: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: By swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.
